We decompose the fraction into a sum of partial fractions, as follows:

$$
\frac{8{s}^{3}-24}{{s}^{5}}=\frac{8}{{s}^{2}}-\frac{24}{{s}^{5}}
$$

From the table of Laplace transforms, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}L{t} & =\frac{1}{{s}^{2}},\,s>0, \\ L{{t}^{4}} & =\frac{24}{{s}^{5}},\,s>0.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, using the addition and multiplication properties of the inverse Laplace transform, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{L}^{-1}{\frac{8}{{s}^{2}}-\frac{24}{{s}^{5}}} & =8{L}^{-1}{\frac{1}{{s}^{2}}}-{L}^{-1}{\frac{24}{{s}^{5}}} \\  & =8t-{t}^{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

So the inverse Laplace transform of $F(s)=\frac{8{s}^{3}-24}{{s}^{5}}$ is $f(t)=8t-{t}^{4}.$
